description: SIG-GR: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SIG-GR. Coverage: SIG-GR. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Lignes de bus AVL; Lignes de bus TICE; Cartographie des passages busés/canalisés/couverts 2021; Transport en commun. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
